# Fix recipes, one per checklist item

Fix in source (templates, data, build script), rebuild, re-audit. Snippets assume a static site with a Node build and an Apache-style host (`.htaccess`); adapt the mechanism, keep the outcome.

## 1. sitemap.xml (generated by the build)

```js
const SITE = "https://example.com";
const urls = pages.filter((p) => p.indexable).map((p) => `  <url><loc>${SITE}${p.path}</loc><lastmod>${today}</lastmod></url>`);
write("sitemap.xml", `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n${urls.join("\n")}\n</urlset>\n`);
```
Only canonical URLs (extensionless, one host), never a noindex page. Serve as `application/xml` (`AddType application/xml .xml` if the host guesses wrong).

## 2. robots.txt

```
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml
```
Do not disallow a page you want de-indexed via `noindex`: Google must crawl it to see the tag.

## 3. noindex

Grep every template for `name="robots"`. Keep it only where the page must not rank (ad landers, dynamic shells, thank-you pages, staging). Removing it from a home page is a publishing decision: name the page in the PR.

## 4. canonical

One self-referencing tag per indexable page, absolute, on the one true host, in the one true URL form:
```html
<link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/personal-loans" />
```
Build it from the page's slug, never from `location.href`.

## 5, 6. titles and descriptions

Title 30 to 60 characters, `Subject | Brand`. Description 70 to 160 characters, one sentence that says what the visitor gets. Both unique per page. They are copy: the site's voice, no keyword lists.

## 7, 8. one H1, no skipped levels

One `<h1>` per page, the subject. Going down the page, never skip a level (h2 to h4 is a skip). Footer column labels ("Other options", "Legal") are not headings: use `<p class="foot-h">` with the old heading's styling. A card heading inside the hero that comes before the first h2 must be an h2, not an h3.

## 9. alt text

Every `<img>` carries `alt`. Content photographs get a plain description of the scene ("Hands on a calculator beside a stack of receipts"), never keywords. Decorative images (poster stills under a video, repeated tiles) keep `alt=""` and `aria-hidden="true"`. Keep alt text in the data file next to the image path so the build and the runtime use the same words.

## 10. schema (JSON-LD)

Only what is true and on the page. Escape `<` as `<` inside the script tag.
```json
[{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","name":"Brand","url":"https://example.com/","logo":"https://example.com/icon-512.png"},
 {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebSite","name":"Brand","url":"https://example.com/"}]
```
Landers with a FAQ: `FAQPage` with `mainEntity` built from the same data the page renders. Inner pages: `BreadcrumbList` (Home, then the page). Articles: `Article` with an Organization author and `dateModified`. Validate with `JSON.parse` in a build test.

## 11. internal links

Every indexable page reachable from the nav or footer. Add new content (an article) to the footer link list so every page links it. Links use the canonical form (extensionless, root-relative `/slug`).

## 12. broken links and retired URLs

Audit script lists them. Retired URLs answer 301 from `.htaccess`:
```
RewriteRule ^old-slug/?$ /new-slug [R=301,L]
```

## 13. images

Stills: 1200 to 1600 px wide, under 200 KB (`ffmpeg -i in.jpg -vf scale=1400:-2 -q:v 4 out.jpg`). Hero loops under 900 KB. Delete files nothing references (grep the source). Set `width`/`height` on every `<img>` (or an `aspect-ratio` in CSS) so nothing shifts while loading; `loading="lazy"` below the fold, `fetchpriority="high"` on the LCP image.

## 14. Core Web Vitals

Measure first: `audit.mjs <url> --lighthouse` (mobile). Usual wins in order: self-host the web font (`@font-face` with a local `woff2`, `font-display: swap`, `<link rel="preload" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>`) and drop the Google Fonts stylesheet and preconnects; image dimensions; hero video `preload="metadata"` with a poster; inline critical CSS (already the case when the build inlines the stylesheet); brotli or gzip on (check `content-encoding`); long `cache-control` on images, media and fonts.

## 15. mobile

Viewport meta, no horizontal scroll at 375, 44 px tap targets, text at least 16 px in inputs. A layout audit script per project beats Lighthouse's generic check.

## 16. HTTPS and one host

```
# http to https and www to apex, one hop each
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.(.+)$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ https://%1%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
```
Test the chain with `curl -sI` for http://www, https://www, http://apex.

## 17. clean slugs and URL variants

Links are lowercase, hyphenated, extensionless. `.html` and trailing-slash forms 301 to the clean form (match the original request so internal rewrites are untouched):
```
RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} \s/+(.+?)\.html[\s?] [NC]
RewriteRule ^ /%1 [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} \s/+index[\s?] [NC]
RewriteRule ^ / [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule ^(.+)/$ /$1 [R=301,L]
```
Then the existing extensionless rule serves `slug.html`. Keep `index.html` at `/`.

## 18. OG image and social tags

1200x630 JPEG under 300 KB per page type (a cropped hero still works; text in the image must be readable at 300 px wide). Absolute URLs:
```html
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<meta property="og:site_name" content="Brand" />
<meta property="og:title" content="…" />
<meta property="og:description" content="…" />
<meta property="og:url" content="https://example.com/slug" />
<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/og/slug.jpg" />
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" /><meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
```
Make the images once (`ffmpeg -i still.jpg -vf "scale=1200:-2,crop=1200:630" -q:v 4 og/slug.jpg`) and commit them; CI builders rarely have ffmpeg.

## 19. Search Console (owner)

Options, easiest first: DNS TXT record at the registrar (verifies the whole domain, survives redeploys); or a `google-site-verification` meta tag rendered by the build from a data field (the token is public, safe to commit); or the HTML file method (only if the deploy does not delete unknown files). Then submit `sitemap.xml` and request indexing for the home page and the money pages.

## 20. backlink strategy (owner, template)

1. The linkable asset: the one page worth citing (a calculator, a worked example, an explainer with real numbers). Make it the best page on the site before asking anyone to link.
2. Directories and profiles that accept a link: business listings, the parent company's site, partner and network pages, industry directories.
3. Ten outreach targets: blogs and newsletters in the niche that already link to comparable explainers; pitch the asset, not the home page.
4. Answer questions where the asset fits (forums, Q&A sites) with disclosure; never spam.
5. Track: referring domains monthly (Search Console "Links" report is free).
